prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1422; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was backing out of a space when it made contact with the claimant's vehicle at the rear quarter panel. Both drivers reported no police response was requested. Photos of both vehicles requested from the insured and the claimant.

Entry 2: Claimant contacted by phone. She reports a shoulder injury from the impact, describing pain when raising her right arm. She states she has not retained an attorney and wishes to handle the claim directly. Advised claimant of the medical documentation needed and that she may seek care from her own provider. Recorded her preferred contact method.

Entry 3: Insured's recorded statement taken. Insured states they checked mirrors but did not see the claimant's vehicle approaching from the adjacent lane. Insured confirms no prior claims on this policy in the past several years. Estimate requested from the body shop for the rear bumper and quarter panel repair.

Entry 4: Received the repair estimate for the claimant's vehicle. Damage is limited to the rear bumper cover, tail lamp assembly, and a dented quarter panel. Total repair estimate is within the range expected for this type of impact. Claimant's injury file remains open pending records from her treating provider.

Entry 5: Claimant returned the medical authorization form and submitted initial treatment notes showing diagnosis of a shoulder strain with a recommended course of physical therapy. Reviewed liability as the insured's vehicle was backing; preliminary assessment indicates the insured is primarily at fault. File referred for bodily injury evaluation and the adjuster will follow up with the claimant once the therapy progress report is received.
